scripts.//test: --timeout IS THE ONLY WAY TO MOVE THE CEILING, and this is where #414's 20 s was actually meant to live. `[test] timeout` is not a bunfig.toml key: bun ignores unknown keys silently, so bunfig.toml's `timeout = 20000` has never applied and this suite — which starts a real daemon, a worker and child processes per test — has been on bun's 5 s default since #414 landed. That is why #458 kept collecting engine timeouts afterwards. The `eventually`/`until` helpers in test/*.test.ts carry the matching 15 s wall-clock bound, so a wait can outlast a loaded runner without outlasting this ceiling.
